text: a quiet pond where I tap to drop my fishing hook into the water, a fish that comes along and grabs on and holds tight until I tap again to reel it up, a little sign that tells me when a fish is on my hook, and my catch count going up by one with every fish I land. With ?test=1 in the address, every duration is at most 2 seconds.

contract.#pond: canvas showing the pond, the hook and the fish, tapped to drop the line and reel it in
contract.#bite: display that tells me when a fish is on the hook
contract.#caught: display of the count of fish I have landed

text: I type or paste my writing into the box and it shows me straight away how many words, characters and sentences I've written, updating as I type.

contract.#writing-box: textarea where I type or paste my writing
contract.#word-count: display showing the number of words
contract.#character-count: display showing the number of characters
contract.#sentence-count: display showing the number of sentences

text: As I type my essay into the big box, the numbers keep up with me: the word count climbs with every word, the character count with every letter, and the sentence count ticks up each time I end one with a period.

contract.#text-box: textarea where the person types their text
contract.#word-count: display showing how many words are in the text
contract.#char-count: display showing how many characters are in the text
contract.#sentence-count: display showing how many sentences are in the text

text: a little run page: I type how far I ran in kilometres and tap add, it puts the run on my list and adds it to my total for the week, and I tap clear to start the week over.

contract.#distance: input where I type how far I ran in kilometres
contract.#add: button that adds the typed distance to my week
contract.#clear: button that starts the week over
contract.#total: display of my total kilometres for the week
contract.#log: display of the list of runs I have added
